source.candidateCommitPolicy: Commit this exact inventory as one clean source candidate; the candidate commit is the commit containing this manifest.

dispositions.keep_release: Retain this path change in the source release candidate.
dispositions.delete_old_implementation: Commit the deletion or cleanup so the obsolete implementation no longer ships.
dispositions.other_work_not_in_release: Leave outside this candidate. No current dirty path matched this disposition.

project_harness.description: Root self-hosting project context and bounded consistency checks.

control_center_release_ui.description: User-visible Control Center release redesign, recovery paths, accessibility, and regression coverage.

session_room_skill_flow.description: Pi-native Session/Room composition, compact Skills, routing cards, and installed-runtime synchronization.

desktop_semantic_accessibility.description: Accessibility-only semantic desktop bridge, bounded find, metrics, smoke target, and foreground verifier.

memory_curation.description: Owner-scoped memory curation and source/pagination correctness.

room_kernel_cleanup.description: Removal of obsolete heavy-Kernel-specific test obligations without rewriting immutable migrations.

cleanupReceipts.reason: Stale handoff referenced retired fixed-pipeline Skills and was explicitly forbidden by the public-source audit.
Formatting-only edits would have changed the migration checksum for installed databases.

verification.pythonFullSuiteShards: 3245 tests across four shards; one shard exposed only 3 stale voice UI copy assertions, and its corrected voice module reran 8/8 passed
verification.agentToolMatrix: 29/29 Pi runtime Tools invoked successfully in a real Room Session
verification.localInstall: pending clean candidate commit and build gates
verification.foregroundAcceptance: not claimed by this source scope
